pack_hash_algorithm: sha256 of sorted UTF-8 lines: <file sha256><two spaces><relative path><newline>

task_suffix.skirt: Revise the middle section of the plain T-90M exterior side skirt into the three broad matte protective-looking cover panels in the sketch. Show distinct narrow joints, shaped lower corners and a restrained top edge. The edit is a scale-model cosmetic study. The patch is approximately six times as wide as it is tall. Use shallow relief relative to the panel height.
task_suffix.hub: Refine the visible Tunguska outer wheel hub cap with a restrained pressed-cover appearance. The sketch calls for a continuous circular perimeter lip, a darker inset band and a softly crowned center. Preserve the tire. The patch is square and its full depth allowance is about one sixth its width.
task_suffix.vent: Refine the blank front face of a freestanding civil industrial ventilation display cabinet. Match the sketch’s softened square bezel, circular inner surround, and six shaped horizontal slats over a darker backing. The patch is square; the full outward allowance is about one tenth its width.
